audience: winemakers and cellar teams who track vessels, wine batches and work orders in vintrace

useCases.title: Find which tanks and barrels hold a wine
useCases.text: The AI reads the vessel contents report (volume, batch, owner, winery as at a date), and lists wine batches with the vessels they sit in.

useCases.title: Check the work orders for this week
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders (transfers, additions, bottling) with status, assignee and scheduled time, and opens one for its jobs and steps.

useCases.title: Follow lab requests waiting for results
useCases.text: The AI lists analysis tasks with lab, vessel, batch and status, and reads the latest lab metrics, such as pH and Brix, of the wine in each vessel.

useCases.title: Track fruit bookings and intakes for a vintage
useCases.text: The AI lists active fruit bookings with grower, block and expected pick time, and the fruit intakes weighed in so far, for a vintage.

useCases.title: Check stock on hand
useCases.text: The AI reads quantity, committed, on order and available stock per item and location up to a date, and looks up a stock item by code.

useCases.title: Assign a work order or add a stock item note
useCases.text: The AI assigns a work order to an operator, or adds a note to a stock item that everyone in the winery can see.
